messages:
marco: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem. Need concrete owners + dates to convert findings into tests/evals/load+chaos drills. Proposal below: regression tests, eval promptset + metrics, a short load spike, a one-node chaos drill, and a dashboard check. Please confirm.

cheng_z: I can own the regression tests. Plan: `tests/kv_eviction_regress/` with deterministic repros + a latency-distribution check. PR1 (repro cases) by 04/08, PR2 (dist checks + nightly wiring) by 04/15.

samir: I'll own the promptsets/evals (EVAL-620). Will include long-prefix, repeat-token, and truncated-stream cases. Adding seq-level fuzzy thresholds and a small hallucination metric. Promptset PR by 04/07, run eval 04/10.

qa-jen: I'll own CI gating. Add a `kv-evict-regress` job that blocks merges on failures and surfaces flaky counts. Need Cheng's test names and Samir's golden outputs. Target to have gating in place by 04/12.

dina_oncall: I'll run the load spike + chaos drill. Proposed: k6 30m at 2x burst, then a chaos run that cordons and reboots one GPU worker mid-spike while we measure KV miss ratio and p95/p99. Tentative in staging 04/11 09:30-11:00 PT. I'll post runbook in #eng-oncall.

lucy_ops: I'll add a small dashboard panel for KV miss ratio and a regression alert that triggers when miss_ratio > 1.5% for 10m during tests. Also add a smoke dashboard check for pre-deploy.

incident-bot: created TASK-PLAT-1010: "kv eviction regression + evals + chaos" assigned to cheng_z.

marco: Owners recap for PM-FU-5120: cheng_z -> regression tests (TASK-PLAT-1010), samir -> promptset/eval (EVAL-620), dina_oncall -> load & chaos (TASK-OPS-645), qa-jen -> CI gating, lucy_ops -> dashboard/alerts. Please confirm ETAs and add PR links to the follow-up ticket.

cheng_z: Confirmed. I'll also add a tiny deploy smoke `curl` for cache warm: `curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warm_kv_0"}'` and include instructions in the README.

samir: Confirmed. Will include both token and sequence scoring; fuzzy-match at 80-90% based on case.

dina_oncall: Confirmed. I'll post the exact staging slot + checklist by EOD.

qa-jen: Confirmed. I'll open the gating PR once Cheng's first PR is merged and Samir's golden outputs are attached.

lucy_ops: Confirmed. Dashboard panel and alert PR by 04/09.

incident-bot: linked TASK-PLAT-1010 -> PM-FU-5120, EVAL-620, TASK-OPS-645.

marco: Thanks all. I'll own the follow-up ticket PM-FU-5120 and run weekly check-ins until everything is green. Closing this thread unless blockers. :thumbsup:
